CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.
   B. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Jeremiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophet Jeremiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.
   C. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.
   C. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Principles of Good Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Principles of Good Stewardship.
   C. Apply the teaching of Principles of Good Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Principles of Good Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   D. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.
   C. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.
   C. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Church Doctrine Sin and Salvation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Healthy Male-Female Relationships Setting Boundaries in Relationships and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Moral Challenges Facing the Youth Today and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Approaches to Leisure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. D — Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Church Doctrine Sin and Salvation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Moral Challenges Facing the Youth Today; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Christian Approaches to Leisure; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
